metrics.investment_case_interpretation: 折后可持续可分配现金利润为正，且市值/折后现金利润约 9.5 年，进入赚钱且便宜榜；扣除折后可剥离净现金后，经营业务购买价约 4,424 万港元，对应折后回本约 1.1 年。该结论依赖保守现金折扣和利润折扣，不构成买卖建议。

cash_breakdown.item: HKD/other currency cash, time deposits and certificate of deposits
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: No restriction disclosed and no bank borrowings, but annual report only provides group-level cash, not parent/subsidiary split.
cash_breakdown.reason: Group cash and deposits excluding disclosed RMB and VND balances; treated as potentially detachable with ordinary subsidiary/group-level haircut.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: RMB is not freely convertible;年报披露可通过授权银行兑换，但未证明可快速上翻至上市主体。
cash_breakdown.reason: 可剥离但受跨境、子公司和汇兑路径约束。

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: VND not freely convertible, cash partly supports Vietnam cement, property and hotel operations; no parent/subsidiary split.
cash_breakdown.reason: 可通过授权银行兑换但现实上翻和汇兑摩擦较大。

cash_breakdown.item: Listed overseas equity investments at FVTPL
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Listed trading investment, small amount, normal market liquidity haircut.

cash_breakdown.item: Unlisted Hong Kong investments at FVTPL
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Unlisted investment despite FVTPL classification; realization path less certain.
cash_breakdown.reason: 可考虑处置但不能按现金等价物处理。

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Annual report MD&A disclosed debt-free position with no bank or other borrowings.
cash_breakdown.reason: 无银行或其他借款需要从可剥离现金中扣除。

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Lease liabilities relate to continuing operations and are reflected in profit/cash-flow quality instead of mechanically deducting all lease debt from detachable cash.
cash_breakdown.reason: 已核对但不作为控股现金剥离融资债务扣除。

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Conservative reserve for cement, hotel and rental operations, based on revenue scale, operating cost base and cash-flow volatility.
cash_breakdown.reason: 买下公司后维持正常经营所需现金，不可剥离。

cash_breakdown.item: Tenant deposits, rental receipts in advance and contract liabilities cash coverage
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Deposits received HK$41.716m plus contract liabilities HK$3.829m are customer/tenant obligations.
cash_breakdown.reason: 对应经营负债的现金不能视为控股股东可自由抽走。

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX and dividend friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Reserve for RMB/VND conversion, cross-border dividend, tax and execution frictions.
cash_breakdown.reason: 年报披露人民币和越南盾不可自由兑换，且资产与经营主体跨香港、中国内地和越南。

profit_quality.assessment: 三年经营现金流持续为正，2023/2024/2025 经营自由现金流约为 9,976 万、9,968 万和 7,342 万港元；但报表利润被投资物业公允价值、物业/酒店/水泥资产减值和利息收入扭曲。用于主排序的折前可分配现金利润取 6,000 万港元，再因水泥和酒店分部亏损、跨境现金、物业重估波动和未拆维持性资本开支打 0.70 折扣。
adjustments: 已把现金和定期存款本金作为可剥离资金扣除，因此 2025 年 2,092 万港元利息收入不计入可持续经营现金利润。
剔除投资物业公允价值亏损 4,370 万港元、物业转投资物业重估损失 840 万港元等非现金项目对当年报表利润的扰动。
三年经营现金流强于净利润，但 2024 和 2023 存在较大的营运资金释放和资产减值加回，因此没有直接用最好年份自由现金流作分母。
租赁负债不从可剥离现金中机械扣除，继续经营所需租赁压力体现在利润折扣中。
profit_quality.haircut_reason: 现金流稳定但业务混合，水泥和酒店亏损，投资物业估值和跨境汇兑风险明显，且无法精确拆出维持性资本开支。
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: 经营现金流对利润有支持，但不能简单按报表净利润或利息收入外推。
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: 年报披露资本开支 1,462 万港元，但未拆维持/增长；按近三年资本开支量级和利润折扣保守处理。
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2023-2025 营运资金多为释放或小幅占用，未用最好年份美化分母。
